description: This file is the __init__.py file for the models package, primarily used for organizing and exporting Pydantic model classes related to cart management.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an individual item in the shopping cart, including details such as item ID, name, quantity, price, etc.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents the entire shopping cart, likely including a collection of CartItems and related metadata.

classes.name: CartResponse
classes.description: Schema used for API responses involving cart data.

classes.name: CartItemRequest
classes.description: Schema for client requests to add or update cart items.

classes.name: UpdateQuantityRequest
classes.description: Schema for requests to update the quantity of a cart item.
